data_gates.provenance: Archive immutable pregame snapshots at least two minutes before scheduled start.
data_gates.scoring: Grade only finalized games; reconcile first-quarter team points against play-by-play.

validation.legacy_audit: 2026-11-12 historical prediction report before kickoff, 85 grades, starting lineups not previously verified, no sportsbook lines.
validation.holdout: 2025/2026 retrospective cross-season and intra-season experiments; no untouched future predictions graded yet.
validation.success_gate: Promote only after future-only, preregistered paired tests across varied dates/teams; sufficient n per market, material error/calibration gains, bootstrap uncertainty; no cherry-picking.
validation.profit_gate: Real bettable 1Q lines and odds, vig, market availability, rejected/unfilled wagers, closing-line value and out-of-sample net ROI required.
